title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
description: Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team! We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet. We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates. How we work: Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies. Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations. AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs. Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them. Your responsibilities: Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions. Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal. Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers. Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments. Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build. Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn. What you should bring: At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar). You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them. Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state. Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes. You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests. You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments. Fluent German and English. Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing. Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA. Why you should work at Famedly: Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector. Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments. Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape. Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths. Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens. Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space! Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year. Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club. A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome. Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit. We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you! Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you! Instead of a cover letter, send us a link to something you've built (Rust preferred) and two or three sentences about how you work with coding agents. title: Storeleitung (m/w/d) Kreativwerkstatt
description: NØA CERAMICS ist mehr als ein Ort zum Keramikbemalen – wir schaffen Raum für Kreativität, Begegnung und besondere Erlebnisse. In unserem Studio in Leipzig verbinden wir handwerkliche Kreativität mit einer inspirierenden Atmosphäre und bringen Menschen zusammen. Mit viel Leidenschaft, Offenheit und Freude am gemeinsamen Gestalten möchten wir begeistern und einzigartige Momente schaffen. Dafür suchen wir kreative und engagierte Menschen, die unsere Begeisterung teilen und gemeinsam mit uns NØA CERAMICS weiterentwickeln möchten. Deine Aufgaben in der Kreativwerkstatt Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung und Organisation des gesamten Studioalltags sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Betriebsabläufe. Umsetzung und aktive Weiterentwicklung unseres bestehenden Kreativ- und Workshopkonzepts. Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Workshops, Veranstaltungen und kreativen Angeboten für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Professionelle Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kund:innen sowie aktive Vermarktung und Verkauf unserer Angebote und Produkte. Organisation und ansprechende Präsentation von Produkten, Ausstellungen, Märkten und Veranstaltungen. Mitwirkung an der Vermarktung unserer Angebote sowie Erstellung kreativer Social-Media-Inhalte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit. Pflege und Ausbau von Kooperationen mit Schulen, Kitas und weiteren Netzwerkpartnern, inkl. Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen und Förderung einer lebendigen Community. Einbringen eigener Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Angebote, Veranstaltungsformate und des gesamten Studiokonzepts. Dein Profil Fachliche Qualifikationen: Erfahrung in der Organisation von Veranstaltungen, Workshops oder Kundenaktionen ist wünschenswert. Idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit kreativen, handwerklichen oder erlebnisorientierten Angeboten. Die Bereitschaft, sich in Themen wie Keramik, Töpfern, Modellieren und weitere kreative Techniken einzuarbeiten, setzen wir voraus. Sicherer Umgang mit Kassensystemen, MS Office und digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung verkaufsfördernder Maßnahmen sowie ein gutes Gespür für Sortimentsgestaltung und Umsatzpotenziale. Kenntnisse in Warenwirtschaft, Bestandskontrolle, Warenannahme, Lagerorganisation und Verkaufsflächenpflege. Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Organisation und Steuerung eines Verkaufsbereichs sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Einzelhandel, insbesondere in der Verkaufsorganisation, Warenpräsentation und Kundenberatung. Idealerweise eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Einzelhandel, im Verkauf oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Qualifikation. Persönliche Kompetenzen: Identifikation mit den Werten Inklusion, Vielfalt und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe. Zuverlässigkeit, Selbstständigkeit und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Flexibilität und die Fähigkeit, auch in lebhaften Situationen den Überblick zu behalten und Prioritäten zu setzen. Kreativität, Offenheit und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themenbereiche und Produkte einzuarbeiten. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst selbst mit an, erkennst Handlungsbedarf und setzt Lösungen eigenständig um. Kommunikationsstärke, sicheres Auftreten und Freude am Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Menschen. Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, Arbeitsabläufe, Warenbestände und Verkaufsprozesse strukturiert zu koordinieren. Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Freude am aktiven Verkauf und an der Kundenbindung. Unternehmerisches Denken, Eigeninitiative und ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Bereitschaft, den Einzelhandelsbereich eigenständig zu führen und aktiv weiterzuentwickeln. Rahmenbedingungen Arbeitszeit: 39 Stunden pro Woche Einsatzplanung: Flexibel von Montag bis Sonntag, orientiert an unseren Workshop- und Veranstaltungszeiten. Verantwortungsbereich: Eigenständige Organisation und Steuerung des Kreativstudios mit vielseitigen Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Benefits Eine sinnstiftende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Einen neuen kreativen Begegnungsort im Aufbau und Betrieb Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mitten in Leipzig 30 Tage Urlaub Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Benefit Card (steuerfreier Sachbezug) Fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Ein wertschätzendes, motiviertes Team Kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen Die Möglichkeit, Kreativität, Begegnung und Teilhabe aktiv mitzugestalten Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Wir freuen uns besonders über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und setzen uns aktiv für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein. Wenn du Lust hast, Menschen zu begeistern, kreative Prozesse zu begleiten und einen lebendigen Ort für Begegnung, Gestaltung und Gemeinschaft mit aufzubauen, freuen wir uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung. title: B2B Marketing - India
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. What you'll do Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. Requirements 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle. Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI. Deep knowledge of the Indian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network. Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact. Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. description: Über die Stelle Kein Bock auf einen Job in einem Unternehmen, das es wegen KI in einem Jahr eh nicht mehr gibt? Was es dann noch geben wird: geile Snacks. Die ersetzt dir keine KI. Bei uns verschwindest du nicht in einer Abteilung, sondern sitzt direkt neben den Gründern und siehst, wie ein Food-Startup von innen funktioniert. Heute baust du eine neue Landingpage, morgen vibe-codest du eine App für unsere internen Prozesse, übermorgen schreibst du Skripte für Meta-Ads und darfst beim Dreh selbst mit vor der Kamera (Wenn du es möchtest). Wir suchen keinen Spezialisten, sondern jemanden, der Probleme löst, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge zu Ende bringt. Wachstum & neue Kanäle: Du findest heraus, wo SNACKL als Nächstes hin sollte, rechnest es durch und bringst es an den Start. Operations & Logistik: Du behältst Bestände, Nachbestellungen und Fulfillment im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Snacks zuverlässig bei Kunden und Partnern ankommen. raw.description:
Über die Stelle

Kein Bock auf einen Job in einem Unternehmen, das es wegen KI in einem Jahr eh nicht mehr gibt? Was es dann noch geben wird: geile Snacks. Die ersetzt dir keine KI.

Genau daran arbeiten wir. SNACKL ist der herzhafte Proteinsnack, mit dem wir Deutschland eine neue Snack-Kultur geben wollen. Unterstützt werden wir von dem besten Food-VC Deutschlands, und sind auf steilem Wachstumskurs.

Bei uns verschwindest du nicht in einer Abteilung, sondern sitzt direkt neben den Gründern und siehst, wie ein Food-Startup von innen funktioniert. Als Founder’s Associate bist du unser Generalist: Du springst dorthin, wo es gerade brennt, und übernimmst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, egal ob Website, Marketing, Operations oder Finance. Heute baust du eine neue Landingpage, morgen vibe-codest du eine App für unsere internen Prozesse, übermorgen schreibst du Skripte für Meta-Ads und darfst beim Dreh selbst mit vor der Kamera (Wenn du es möchtest).

Wir suchen keinen Spezialisten, sondern jemanden, der Probleme löst, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge zu Ende bringt.

Womit du Wirkung erzielt

  • Website & Tech: Du baust und optimierst unseren Shopify-Shop mit, setzt neue Seiten und Features um und scheust dich nicht vor ein bisschen Code, auch mit Hilfe von KI.
  • Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du findest Abläufe, die noch manuell laufen, und baust sie smarter auf, von internen Tools bis zu automatisierten Workflows.
  • Wachstum & neue Kanäle: Du findest heraus, wo SNACKL als Nächstes hin sollte, rechnest es durch und bringst es an den Start.
  • Operations & Logistik: Du behältst Bestände, Nachbestellungen und Fulfillment im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Snacks zuverlässig bei Kunden und Partnern ankommen.
  • Finance & Analyse: Du unterstützt bei Reportings, Kalkulationen und Auswertungen und lernst, Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen zu treffen.
  • Founder Projects: Du übernimmst strategische Sonderprojekte direkt mit dem Gründerteam, von Events bis zur Vorbereitung neuer Vertriebskanäle.

Dein Profil

  • Generalist: Du hast Lust auf viele Themen gleichzeitig und arbeitest dich schnell in Neues ein, ob Excel-Modell, Shopify-Theme oder Content-Konzept.
  • KI-affin: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT nicht nur für Texte, sondern um echte Arbeit schneller und besser zu erledigen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Vibe Coding, Automatisierung oder bauen eigener Apps sind ein großes Plus.
  • Strukturiert: Du schaffst Ordnung im Chaos, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei mehreren Baustellen den Überblick.
  • Zahlenverständnis: Du hast keine Angst vor Zahlen und verstehst, was hinter einer Marge oder einer Conversion Rate steckt.
  • Echte Motivation: Du hast den Drive, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, und willst in einem Early-Stage Startup wirklich etwas bewegen.

Das passt zu dir, wenn...

  • ... du lieber viele verschiedene Dinge machst, als dich auf eine Aufgabe zu beschränken.
  • ... du Verantwortung suchst und auch in der „Startup-Chaos-Phase“ selbst Struktur schaffst.
  • ... du lieber schnell umsetzt und testest, als monatelang am „perfekten“ Konzept zu feilen.
  • ... du dir vorstellen kannst, später selbst zu gründen, und dir genau das aus nächster Nähe anschauen willst.

Das passt eher nicht, wenn...

  • ... du klare 9-to-5-Strukturen und ein fertiges Handbuch für jede Aufgabe brauchst.
  • ... du dich auf ein Fachgebiet spezialisieren willst und keine Lust auf Abwechslung hast.
  • ... dir Aufgaben „unter deinem Niveau“ zu schade sind, denn bei uns packt jeder überall mit an.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Output over Presence: Wir entscheiden nach Ergebnissen. Wir halten Hierarchien flach, Meetings kurz und das Tempo hoch.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst Einblick in wirklich alle Bereiche eines Early-Stage Food Startups, von Produktion über Marketing bis Finanzierung, und lernst direkt vom Gründerteam.
  • AI-first Arbeiten: Du lernst, wie man mit modernen KI-Tools in kurzer Zeit Websites, Apps, Prozesse und Kampagnen baut, ein Skill, der dir überall Türen öffnet.

title: Principal Software Developer (f/m/d) - Market Data
description: Company Description Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring! Job Overview Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices. Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team. You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you! Your Tasks Designing and implementing challenging projects to develop our data processing pipeline. Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run. Engineering ETL processes. Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors. Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data. Your Profile 8+ years of software development, data engineering, or relevant experience, including at least 5 years of in-depth Python experience. Software Engineering: good understanding of microservice architectures, Liskov’s Substitution Principle, design patterns, and dynamic dispatch. Databases: experience with at least one SQL/NoSQL database, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including schema definition and evolution, as well as ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy, JPA, or Hibernate. Cloud / Cloud-native development: Google Cloud Platform (GCP). CI/CD: ability to define build pipelines and perform, validate, and monitor deployments. Good understanding of microservice architectures. Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology. Git: ability to use Git from the command line and apply version-control management practices (e.g., Gitflow, trunk-based development). Strong technical mentoring skills. Full professional proficiency in English. Communication: ability to illustrate ideas and concepts with figurative examples to both stakeholders and developers. Ability to perceive the business domain in terms of mathematical structures is appreciated. Our Offer Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting. Get to know the dynamics of an established, successful FinTech company. Free choice of your gears to work comfortably and effectively. Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy. Seize the opportunity to develop personally, take over responsibility and maintain direct customer contact from day one. Flexible work environment with a hybrid work model and 30 annual vacation days. Receive numerous benefits (e.g. Regular staff parties, team events, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space, activity room, free beverages and fruit baskets). Berlin, hybrid: im Praktikum mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche im Office, als Werkstudent:in mindestens 2. Start ab sofort, für mindestens 6 Monate, bezahlt, danach ist eine Festanstellung möglich. Was du machst Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können. Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen. Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien. Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt. title: Business Development Manager in a disruptive scale-up: be a changemaker and learn to build a company
description: (Offices: Berlin, Frankfurt) As Business Development Manager guide enterprise clients in changing their business, using our AI-powered go-to-market Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies, “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received €20 million in Series A financing round. Vicos consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e.g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies. Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of members work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Capgemini. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market. Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new way of organizing human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers all essential areas end-to-end: marketing, finance, legal, and organization. Why we are looking for you We are scaling our go-to-market, AI-first and human-led: AI takes over the busywork, people build the relationships and make the decisions. For that we look for people with a builder’s mindset: you have already built or significantly contributed to something, you work with AI as naturally as with email, and you want to grow fast. Maybe you want to found your own company one day. With us you learn how a disruptive business grows by challenging established practices and offering radically new, superior solutions: from the first contact to the signed contract and the team that delivers. You work on real enterprise deals from the start and take on more responsibility as you grow. What you do • Expand our business: Together with our Chief Growth Officer (your boss) and colleagues, you guide new and existing clients in shifting their supply of services to Vicos. You identify prospects, understand their potential to improve through Vicos and lead them in starting and expanding their work with Vicos. You prepare client meetings, join them with our senior team and Vico Leads (the Vicos’ bosses) and take over your own accounts step by step. • Represent Vicoland at events: Together with Vico Leads and senior colleagues (and increasingly on your own) you attend industry events (conferences, trade fairs etc.). You prepare and execute Vicoland’s event communication aimed at building reputation, raising client interest, and deepening relationships. • Spot and seize opportunities: You are always on the lookout for ways to win new clients or grow business with existing ones: through new channels, new partnerships or ideas nobody has tried yet. You do not wait for assignments or permission: you bring facts and a proposal, act, and measure what works. • Build and run our AI-powered go-to-market: You use, improve and build AI workflows and agents for research, outreach, meeting preparation and content, e.g. with Claude and its connectors to HubSpot, our platform and our wiki. You test new tools and roll out what delivers the best results and keeps us authentic. You share what works as a use case and help turn it into team standards. • Develop Vicos: You work closely with Vico Leads to make sure our offer matches client demand. This includes support in finding new members or AI agents for Vicos, doing the research, communication and meetings needed. You help Vico Leads to onboard new members, integrate new AI agents, sharpen their profiles and win projects. • Influence the market and the company: You create content for LinkedIn and our website incl. blog and you bring back what you learn in the market to improve how we work. Who you are • You have an academic degree, for example in business, engineering, computer science, natural sciences, law or another field. Your subject matters less than your mindset and what you have made of your life so far. • You have some professional experience in which you learned and contributed significantly. All the better if this experience involved innovating established practices and included communication responsibilities. This may have been in diverse fields, for example consulting sales, business development, finance or technology, be it in large organizations, SMEs or startups. The experience may have been gained in regular employment, internships, or working student jobs. • You have built something, alone or together, for example a startup, a student initiative, a sales pipeline, a charity, an AI tool … or anything else that did not exist before and is useful to others. • You use AI every day and like to build your own workflows. Coding skills are a plus. • You are creative, take initiative, work in a structured way and finish what you start. • You enjoy working with people and build trust quickly. • You are curious about enterprise technology. • You speak German and English fluently. Whether you are at the start of your career or already have a few years of experience: we shape the role around what you bring. What we offer • Compensation: A fixed salary, a variable component tied to your commercial success, and company shares (ESOP). • Responsibility: Real responsibility from day one and direct work with our CGO and CEO. • Learning: A steep learning curve in enterprise sales, AI and company building. • Path to entrepreneurship: If you want to build your own company later, you can build your own Vico with our backing. • Flexibility: Hybrid work from Berlin or Frankfurt, with further offices in Barcelona and Seville. • Team: A highly talented team with diverse backgrounds. Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence (d/f/m)
description: Our story: Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence. Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. Your challenge At Taxfix, we have democratized tax filing for millions of people. Now, we are building our next major growth engines. As an Entrepreneur in Residence, you will work directly with our C-level leadership and Management Team to identify, validate, and build new business opportunities. You will take ideas from zero to one and help scale proven businesses from one to one hundred. This role is designed for an ambitious recent graduate or early-career strategy consultant who wants to move from advising businesses to building them. You will operate with high autonomy, turn ambiguous opportunities into clear choices, and help launch ventures that can become meaningful parts of Taxfix’s future. Your team You will join our New Ventures function and work closely with Taxfix’s C-level leadership and Management Team. Depending on the opportunity, you will collaborate with colleagues across Product, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Tax. You will bring the right people together, create clarity in uncertain situations, and drive initiatives from the first hypothesis through validation, launch, and scale. Your responsibilities Identify attractive customer problems and market opportunities through research, customer interviews, competitor analysis, and rapid experimentation. Design and run tests to validate customer demand, willingness to pay, commercial viability, and operational feasibility. Develop compelling propositions, business models, pricing strategies, unit economics, operating models, and go-to-market plans. Move beyond presentations by building prototypes, coordinating pilots, acquiring initial customers, and establishing the foundations for launch. Turn validated ventures into scalable businesses by developing repeatable growth engines, robust operating models, strong teams, and performance management systems. Translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations for the C-level team, Leadership Team, and Board. Mobilise colleagues across Product, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Tax to move ventures forward. Your profile You have a hands-on builder mentality and do not wait for perfect resources or specialist support. You use AI-native tools and vibe coding to rapidly build prototypes, automate workflows, analyse data, and turn ideas into tangible products and experiments—even if you are not a software engineer by training. You are a recent graduate from a leading university or business school, such as WHU, HHL, HSG, HEC, ESADE, or a comparable institution; alternatively, you have up to two or three years of experience at a leading strategy consultancy such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or a comparable firm. You want to build companies, products, or business lines and may aspire to become a founder in the future. You can break ambiguous questions down into hypotheses, analyses, experiments, and clear decisions. You combine strategic depth with a strong bias for action. You are willing to speak with customers, build a model, test a landing page, or solve an operational bottleneck yourself. You understand what creates customer value and can connect it to pricing, unit economics, distribution, and scalable operations. You communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing. You act with pace, resilience, sound judgement, high ownership, and low ego. You are fluent in German and English. Why Taxfix? A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals. Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions. A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like. Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create. 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours. A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts. Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip. Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible. Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions. Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office. Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture. At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves. Abwicklung von Zahlungs- und Transferprozessen: Sie kümmern sich um die Bearbeitung unterschiedlicher bankbezogener Vorgänge, darunter Überweisungen, Festgelder und Devisengeschäfte. Berufliche Erfahrung: Sie konnten bereits Berufserfahrung in einer Assistenzfunktion sammeln. Erfahrungen im Private Banking oder Wealth Management sind dabei von Vorteil. IT-Kenntnisse: Sie gehen sicher mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen um und verfügen idealerweise bereits über Erfahrung mit bankinternen Systemen. Kunden- und Serviceorientierung: Sie zeichnen sich durch eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung aus und legen Wert auf eine zuverlässige, freundliche und professionelle Betreuung. Diskretion und Zuverlässigkeit: Sie behandeln vertrauliche Informationen verantwortungsbewusst und überzeugen durch eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise. We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same. At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary. What you'll be doing Ship features end to end : Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence. Author the contracts and the roadmap : Author and own API contracts and documentation for the department, and maintain a technical roadmap with rigorous written framing - precise intent, explicit trade-offs, and unambiguous success criteria - setting the documentation and spec-writing standard for the area. Drive consistency and lead migrations : Drive consistency across all our web properties, design the standards the department builds on, and lead migration efforts - making full use of new framework features and bringing the rest of engineering along with you. Own quality, security, performance and reliability standards : Set and maintain the security & web performance standards for the frontend, including client-side concerns like CSP, CWV, XSS prevention, data, governance plus reliability standards, incident review culture, and production readiness criteria. Own the build and deployment story : Understand the build and deployment pipeline for our assets and services end to end, monitor and improve it, and make informed, commercially-aware decisions about hosting providers, vendors, and build-vs-buy trade-offs. Develop other engineers : Develop IC3 engineers into technical leaders, raise the technical bar in hiring by defining what "good" looks like in the discipline, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high standards. Lead AI-assisted engineering : Use Kiro and other AI tools to move faster, and set the standards for how the team integrates AI into its everyday workflow and its products. What you'll have Minimum requirements At least 5+ years of experience in focused frontend practice building and operating production web applications at scale, with a track record of leading large, complex projects. The ability to bridge engineering and product fluently, translating between business priorities and technical constraints in both directions, and to make and defend difficult technical decisions under uncertainty through reasoning, not authority. Recognised as a technical authority in frontend engineering - engineers and product stakeholders seek you out for technical direction, and your judgement shapes decisions beyond your immediate team. Deep expertise with modern CSS/SCSS, HTML, and current ECMAScript proposals, and a strong understanding of the trade-offs between different frameworks and the scenarios in which each is the right choice. Comprehensive experience writing unit and E2E tests, and building the CI workflows to exercise them. Deep working knowledge of TypeScript and modern React (hooks, component composition, transitions), and of frameworks like Next.js that handle SSR, routing, and data fetching. Deep experience with observability, Core Web Vitals, accessibility auditing, and frontend performance tuning - and the ability to evaluate new frameworks and identify where we gain an edge in development, deployment, rendering, integration, and performance. Breadth across different teams, and the judgement to make pragmatic build-vs-refactor-vs-replace calls informed by a track record of production crises and scale challenges. A genuine interest in leading AI-assisted development as part of your and the team's workflow. Additional or preferred requirements Experience owning and maintaining a design system, and driving its adoption across multiple teams. The ability to create sensible UI designs without a Designer for non-trivial (though not highly complex) work when the team is resource-constrained. Experience evaluating vendors and third-party tools, and making build-vs-buy recommendations with clear technical and commercial criteria. Experience maintaining and evolving complex legacy systems at scale. Backend fluency - you don't need to be full-stack, but you're comfortable following a request deep into the API layer and shaping the contract on both sides.   • Own the commercial picture for your region. You’ll keep a close eye on churn, risk, renewals and upsell across your team’s accounts, and represent the region at our weekly business reviews with the exec team.

  • Build the playbook with your fellow leads. The regional model is brand new. Alongside the leads for London and the South, you’ll shape how we work, what best practice looks like and how we scale it.

raw.description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the team

We don’t build pricing models, we build the driving intelligence that feeds them. Our mission is to drive safer roads and fairer insurance through data.

The Telematics team transforms raw phone sensor data into meaningful insights about how people drive. Using advanced signal processing and machine learning, we process high-frequency data to extract behavioural signals that power our understanding of driving quality, context, and risk.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist, you’ll contribute to the future of behaviour-based insurance. You’ll contribute to the development of features and algorithms that detect driving patterns from sensors, test new hypotheses, and help bring impactful insights into production.

You’ll work closely at the intersection of data science and engineering, generating scalable, real-world insights from GPS, accelerometer, and other spatial data.

What you will be doing

  • Build and refine behavioural features and factors from telematics data.

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end pipelines in Python and SQL, ranging from simple heuristics to complex machine learning models.

  • Build robust solutions that scale, whether rule-based or ML-driven.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers,Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement features and evaluate their impact.

  • Run experiments, test new ideas, and assist in automating insight generation.

  • Translate complex sensor data into clear insights that can shape our roadmap and product.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • MSc or BSc in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics), or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on experience developing data science or data engineering solutions. You’re comfortable writing production-grade code, not just notebooks.

  • Solid skills in Python and SQL, including standard libraries (Polars, Scipy, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines and tools that are reliable and maintainable.

  • Clear communication skills: able to break down problems into testable hypotheses and collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

  • A growth mindset: curious, eager to learn from senior peers, and open to feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to noisy, high-frequency, or time-series sensor data (e.g., GPS, accelerometer).

  • Familiarity with digital signal processing or sensor physics principles.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and tools like Docker or basic pipeline orchestration.

  • Background or interest in insurance, mobile telemetry, or behavioural modeling.

  • Experience applying Deep Learning models to time-series data.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

production faster.</p> <p>This is a broad, cross-functional role suited to someone who enjoys working across the full stack: data infrastructure, distributed systems, and production ML, and who takes ownership of problems end to end rather than waiting to be told what to fix.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for normalisation) and/or production-grade observability</li> <li>Ability to design resilient, scalable architectures, and comfort operating and troubleshooting distributed systems</li> <li>MLOps We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.</p> <p class="p1">We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.</p> <p class="p1">This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What we can offer you:<br></strong></p> <p class="p1">No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.</p> <p class="p1">We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. description: <p>Graduate Programme — Babyzone</p> <ul> <li><strong>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?&nbsp;</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters?&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p>If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p>We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT US</strong></p> <p>At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p>Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</strong></p> <p>15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust,&nbsp;Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <p>ABOUT BABYZONE</p> <p>Babyzone is&nbsp;an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p>For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul> <li>Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.</li> <li>Training &amp; Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.</li> <li>Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.</li> <li>Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.</li> <li>Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>ARE YOU BC?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curious&nbsp;</strong>– people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’&nbsp;</strong>– surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset –&nbsp;</strong>working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm –&nbsp;</strong>you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.</li> <li><strong>Humble &amp; Sociable&nbsp;</strong>– building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.</li> </ul> <p>If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:</p> <ul> <li>Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC</li> <li>Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone</li> <li>A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere</li> <li>Discretionary bonus</li> <li>25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off</li> <li>Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>APPLICATION &amp; PROCESS</strong></p> <p>If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent.&nbsp;</p> <p>We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:</p> <p>Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Stage 2:</strong>&nbsp;Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>*Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process*</strong></p> <p><em>Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.&nbsp; This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.&nbsp; You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing&nbsp;<a ---------- but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for.&nbsp;You can review our privacy policy<a href="https://www.blenheimchalcot.com/recruitment-privacy-policy/">&nbsp;here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team.

Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations

  • Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation

  • Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers

  • Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps

  • Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team

  • Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations

  • Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums

  • Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team

  • Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events

 

What you bring:

  • 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services

  • A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company

  • Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables

  • Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies

  • Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in

  • A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements

  • Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when

  • The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Bonus:

  • Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs

  • Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure

  • Early-stage startup experience

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

Ready to keep quality at the heart of projects with impact?

Do you want to make a real impact by ensuring quality in services? Are you ready to grow your skills in a supportive, knowledge-sharing community where you can achieve your potential?

We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. As a Quality Assurance consultant, you’ll ensure that quality assurance is considered from the start through testing, questioning and improving. You’ll apply your adaptability and communication skills across a variety of projects, working with a vibrant QA community that champions learning and knowledge sharing.

The Role 

You'll work on public and private sector projects. You’ll likely be working as a lead software quality engineer on internal and client-facing projects, contributing to the leadership of teams. 

Leading by example and promoting the Opencast approach, you’ll support colleagues to develop knowledge and work through challenges in all testing types. You’ll decide the best thing for your team to be working on. You'll collaborate with team members, clients and users to ensure that high quality is maintained and best practices are followed throughout the project. You'll adapt to different tools and technologies, advising on the best ones to use. 

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client. 

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients. 

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements. 

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying. 
 
We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 

Technical Skills 

To succeed in this role, you must have experience working as a lead software tester on multiple complex projects and have a good understanding of what it means to be a senior consultant. 

In your CV and at interview, you’ll need to show experience of: 

  • Your working area and how you apply this to your role

  • Functional and non-functional automation testing using tools like Playwright

  • Mentoring and Coaching team members, supporting their development and progression within QA

  • Creating test documentation

  • Resolving complex issues and presenting findings to stakeholders

  • Creating tasks from high-level requirements

  • Leading and facilitating meetings, including test planning, defect triage, stand-ups and retrospectives

  • Acting as a senior point of contact for stakeholders, demonstrating leadership in both delivery and communication

 

You’ll need a good understanding of: 

  • Basic principles of programming paradigms, such as object-orientated programming and procedural programming 

  • The concepts and benefits of OAT testing. 

 

As well as QA skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be a great consultant.  

In the interview, we will assess how you have: 

  • Demonstrated strong attention to detail and focus on high-quality outcomes

  • Took a methodical approach to resolving complex problems

  • Respectfully challenged decisions or solutions when necessary

  • Communicated effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proactively sought solutions to mitigate risk

  • Raised risks and issues using the appropriate tools and processes

  • Built strong working relationships and successfully resolved conflicts

  • Led project meetings and actively contributed to workshops and events

Other experience 

Some areas of experience are not essential but relevant to the role: 

  • UK government service standards
  • Agile methodology

Salary

£56,001-£60,000

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from flexible working hours (aligned to client commitments), 25 days’ holiday, and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We also offer wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team. 

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.
